note: _orabat dominum deum Israel ut dirigeret viam eius_ – she prayed to the Lord the God of Israel that he would direct her way; sie bat den Herrn, den Gott Israels, dass er ihren Weg lenke. For _viam eius_, with possessive pronoun in the genitive case, it would have to be _viam suam_ in classical Latin. – Kaulen, p. 168.
